newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: NORWAY ROYALS MINGLE WITH CROWDS ON PRAGUE BRIDGE.
newsitem.headline: NORWAY ROYALS MINGLE WITH CROWDS ON PRAGUE BRIDGE.

text.p: Norway's King Harald and his wife Queen Sonja strolled across Prague's six-centuries old Charles Bridge on Tuesday greeting throngs of tourists as they began a three-day state visit to the Czech Republic.

The royal couple joined Czech President Vaclav Havel and his wife Dagmar for the casual walk across the river Vltava in central Prague, admiring the ancient statues lining the stone bridge and saying hello to tourists and locals in several languages.

The King and Queen are scheduled to meet numerous senior Czech officials, visit Prague's Old Town and Jewish Quarter, open a Norwegian arts exhibit and tour the Vitana powdered soup factory majority-owned by Norway-based Rieber & Son.

Earlier, Czech Industry and Trade Minister Vladimir Dlouhy said he would announce on Wednesday a long-term contract for natural gas supplies from Norway during a forum with business leaders attended by King Harald.
